mentions.h: A VICTORY IS TOLLED BY THE BELS. ILFORD ROAD RELAY (10 X 3½ mls)- 19th MARCH

mentions.note: won London County C.C. 1961; leaving for Welwyn A.C.
3rd, 33:47; had beaten O'Hara in the veterans Southern; described as former London cross country champion

photos.c:
NATIONAL VET'S '74

Top: Morris (Birchfield) and Salt (Rochdale) lead the field at the start with Southern Champion Brown/133, Goodfellow/169 and Laurie O'Hara/4 close behind. Centre: At the end of lap 1 the first eight are through and Clive Shippen/7 and Pat Newall/5 lead the chasing field. Bottom: The Belgrave team (with intruder George Brown - former London cross country champion) all smiles after their second successive title win. Left to right - Shippen, Brown, O'Hara and Newall.
